verdict.rationale: BVNK's own docs say you can send stablecoins from a BVNK account, auto on-ramp and send to blockchain addresses via an API rule (POST /payment/v1/rules), and receive real-time HTTP webhooks for payout events. However, no specific crypto payout endpoint or settlement status lifecycle is documented in the pack; the payout-overview material covers fiat bank payouts. Missing for 10: a documented API endpoint for one-off stablecoin payouts to a wallet address, stored crypto recipient/beneficiary support, a documented payout status lifecycle through to on-chain final settlement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send stablecoin payouts programmatically — pay a wallet address or stored recipient through the API with documented status tracking to final settlement

citations.quote: Send stablecoins or cryptocurrencies from your BVNK account.
Automatically on-ramp to crypto and send to blockchain addresses.
To create a rule that links a fiat virtual account to a crypto blockchain address, send the `POST /payment/v1/rules` request
When something happens in your BVNK account, such as a pay-in or a payout, the platform sends an HTTP POST request to a URL you provide with the event details in real time.
